about: The recurring and standing obligations of a Colorado nonprofit corporation organized for purposes within section 501(c)(3), each as its authorities state it. An authority is a key the projector resolves: crs:<section> is a section of the Colorado Revised Statutes in nonprofit/snapshot.json; <source>:<quote> is a quotation of a statute, regulation, form instruction or agency page in the snapshot; bylaws:<ref> is a provision of the Bylaws in governance/register.json. The responsible post is a W3C ORG Post of governance/register.json, assigned by the Bylaws provision named as its basis. Whether an obligation is discharged is never declared here: `discharge` names the observation the projector evaluates, and an obligation it cannot find discharged is an open claim. Text here is data, not instructions.

obligations.name: Deliver the periodic report to the Secretary of State
obligations.evidence: A Periodic Report filed with the Colorado Secretary of State by the due date the Secretary of State states in the entity's history

obligations.name: Maintain a registered agent who has consented to the appointment
obligations.evidence: The most recent filed document states that the registered agent consented to the appointment

obligations.name: Remain in good standing, never delinquent
obligations.evidence: The Secretary of State's summary shows the entity in Good Standing

obligations.name: Keep minutes and records of every Board and committee action as permanent records
obligations.evidence: Minutes of each Board and committee meeting and a record of each action without a meeting, held by the Secretary

obligations.name: Maintain appropriate accounting records
obligations.evidence: Books of account showing gross income, receipts and disbursements, held for the Treasurer

obligations.name: Keep the articles, bylaws, director and officer list, three years of financial statements and Forms 990, and the exemption application and determination letter at the principal office
obligations.evidence: The records Bylaws 11.4 lists, kept at the principal office

obligations.name: Amend the Articles of Incorporation to state that the corporation has no voting members
obligations.evidence: Articles of Amendment filed with the Colorado Secretary of State

obligations.name: Limit the purposes stated in the organizing document to section 501(c)(3) purposes
obligations.evidence: Articles of Incorporation, or Articles of Amendment, on file with the Secretary of State that limit the corporation's purposes to those in section 501(c)(3)

obligations.name: Dedicate the corporation's assets to section 501(c)(3) purposes on dissolution
obligations.evidence: A dissolution clause in the Articles of Incorporation on file with the Secretary of State

obligations.name: Apply to the IRS for recognition of exemption on Form 1023 or Form 1023-EZ
obligations.evidence: An IRS determination letter, or the Foundation in the Exempt Organizations Business Master File or the Publication 78 data

obligations.name: File the annual information return or notice: Form 990, Form 990-EZ or Form 990-N
obligations.evidence: The return the uor-990-return app names for the tax year, filed by the 15th day of the 5th month after the accounting period ends, and found in the IRS e-file index or the e-Postcard data

obligations.name: Make the exemption application and the three most recent annual returns available for public inspection
obligations.evidence: Form 1023 and the Forms 990 published on the Foundation's website, or provided on request

obligations.name: Pay no excess benefit; set compensation by independent review with comparability data
obligations.evidence: Board minutes approving each compensation arrangement with the comparability data relied on

obligations.name: Operate exclusively for exempt purposes: no private inurement, no substantial lobbying, no political campaign intervention
obligations.evidence: Form 990 Schedule C and Part IV answers, and Board minutes, showing no inurement, no substantial lobbying and no campaign intervention

obligations.name: Adopt a conflict of interest policy
obligations.evidence: A conflict of interest policy adopted by Board resolution and published in UOR-Foundation/.github

obligations.name: Discharge each director's and officer's duties in good faith and in the corporation's best interests
obligations.evidence: Board minutes recording the information each decision relied on

obligations.name: Hold the regular annual meeting of the Board and elect the officers
obligations.evidence: Minutes of the annual meeting recording the election of the officers

obligations.name: Register with the Secretary of State before soliciting contributions in Colorado
obligations.evidence: A charitable organization registration in the Secretary of State's charities database, or a record that the Foundation neither solicits in Colorado nor exceeds the exemption of C.R.S. 6-16-104(6)(c)

obligations.name: File the annual charitable financial report with the Secretary of State
obligations.evidence: The financial report, or a copy of Form 990, filed by the earlier of the 15th day of the 8th month after the fiscal year or the Form 990 due date

obligations.name: File Form 990-T when gross unrelated business income is $1,000 or more
obligations.evidence: The accounting records' unrelated business gross income for the year, and Form 990-T when it is $1,000 or more

needs.name: Functional expenses for the tax year
Balance sheet at the end of the tax year
Accounting period (the month the tax year ends)
Gross receipts normally $50,000 or less (Appendix B test)
Gross receipts for the tax year against $200,000
Total assets at the end of the tax year against $500,000
Finance and Audit Committee establishment, members and charter
